component.name: CodexBar
component.summary: Monitor AI provider usage and account limits

description.p: CodexBar is a native Linux usage monitor for AI services. It presents account limits and usage in a terminal interface, desktop status item, Waybar, scripts, and JSON output.
Provider and account data remain separately scoped. Network requests use bounded responses, and local configuration is stored with private permissions.
Adds native distro packages, AppImage delivery, stronger tray discovery, and current z.ai credit limits.
